method.fingerprint_scope: source port and UDP-phase capture, equal wire sizes and SHA-256 prefixes
method.duplicate_fingerprints: matched by minimum multiplicity, excluded from unique associations
method.calibration: successful probes with one eligible exact pair teach wire size and server-side delay
method.candidate_window: starts at loopback receive, ends at next receive or calibration search limit
method.candidate_caveat: time and size indicate a possible association to a probe
method.android_timestamp: userspace socket read, compared only with the same Android probe's deadline
method.missing_fingerprint_caveat: capture gaps, offloads, socket reading and packet loss can all affect visibility
